hard_rules: decision_weight == veto  =>  provenance must be buffett_verbatim
provenance == buffett_verbatim  =>  source_refs must be non-empty
decision_weight == gate  =>  provenance in (buffett_verbatim, buffett_implied) and gate_rule and fallback required

criteria.question: 能否用一段话解释这门生意如何赚钱？
criteria.maps_to_skill: Quick Filter Q1 / Path B 步骤1
criteria.gate_rule: 不通过则直接输出 not_scorable；其余判据不得继续打分
criteria.how_to_measure: 分析者独立写一段生意解释；需依赖外部材料才能写完即视为不通过

criteria.question: 这笔投资最可能以哪三种方式让我亏钱？
criteria.maps_to_skill: Path B 步骤1 逆向检查
source_refs: letter:1981 / 1985 / 1996 ('invert these situations' 巴式逆向原话，待逐字补订)
letter:1987 / 1993 ('Mr. Market' 13处命中，情绪反转框架)
criteria.how_to_measure: 列出 top3 亏损路径；列不出即视为未理解生意

criteria.question: 是否以持有 10 年的视角在评估，而非本季度涨跌？
criteria.maps_to_skill: Path B 步骤1 时间 horizon
criteria.how_to_measure: 结论中必须显式写出 10 年视角下的生意终局判断

criteria.question: 10 年后这家公司是否仍存在且更有竞争力？
criteria.how_to_measure: 技术/模式颠覆风险清单 + 行业生命周期判断

criteria.question: 竞争者认真投入能否复制其核心优势？
criteria.how_to_measure: 五类护城河（无形/成本/转换/网络/效率规模）逐一排除

criteria.question: 护城河在变宽、稳定还是变窄？
criteria.maps_to_skill: Path B 步骤2 关键判断
source_refs: letter:2007 ('moat' 单年 8处，护城河宽度与城堡比喻)
criteria.how_to_measure: 至少 5 年毛利率/市占率/提价记录趋势

criteria.question: 提价 5-10% 是否会显著流失客户？
source_refs: letter:1991 (pricing power 是决定企业成败的首要因素，需按 1991 信原文人工补订)
criteria.how_to_measure: 历史提价记录 + 销量弹性；commodity 型直接判 No
criteria.known_conflict: 原 quote 字段误把 1989 年 'wonderful company' 句挂在本条下；该句已归属 C-wonderful-at-fair。pricing power 主题词 1991 年起出现于信件。

criteria.question: 这是好生意合理价，还是平庸生意便宜价？
criteria.maps_to_skill: Path B 步骤2 总纲
evidence_quote: It's far better to buy a wonderful company at a fair price than a fair company at a wonderful price. (1989 letter)
criteria.how_to_measure: 先定生意质量档（franchise/commodity/hybrid），再谈价格

criteria.question: 管理层是否受机构惯性驱使做非理性扩张/模仿/并购？
criteria.maps_to_skill: Path B 步骤2 警告项
source_refs: letter:1989 (verified_web 2026-10-17, 2 occurrences, first use: an unseen force that we might call the institutional imperative)
criteria.how_to_measure: 并购史 + 资本配置是否跟随同行而非回报驱动

criteria.question: 管理层是否诚实面对问题而非掩盖？
criteria.maps_to_skill: Quick Filter Q7（唯一一票否决）
source_refs: skill:references/04-management-governance.md (quote: You can never make a good deal with a bad person, no matter how attractive the prospects.)
criteria.veto_rationale: 一票否决的实质依据是 bad-person 原话（本地可验证）；年报措辞回避/坏消息延迟披露/审计意见保留即触发
evidence_quote: With a few notable exceptions, I have admired the managers we've had. But our record with managers we admired less than we should have been is poor. ... We've never succeeded in making a good deal with a bad person. (letter:1989, EXACT 回源核验 2026-10-20)
criteria.how_to_measure: 年报中坏消息的位置与措辞 vs 好消息；诉讼/监管披露完整性
criteria.known_conflict: skill references/04 曾把本条转写为祈使句 'You can never make a good deal with a bad person'，该句式在 48 封股东信中不存在；1989 年信原文为第一人称经验陈述（we've never succeeded）。2026-10-20 引语核验纠错。

criteria.question: 利润是否真转化为现金，而非会计技巧？
criteria.how_to_measure: OCF/净利 趋势 + 非经常性损益占比（见 T-nonrecurring-ratio）+ 应收/预付异动

criteria.question: Owner Earnings = 净利 + D&A - 维持性 capex - 营运资本增加，是否为正且稳定？
criteria.maps_to_skill: Path B 步骤3 公式
source_refs: letter:1986 ('owner earnings' 定义段，9处命中)
criteria.how_to_measure: 维持性 capex 年报通常不拆分 => 允许 not_disclosed，不得让模型猜

criteria.question: 行业最坏情形（收入 -30%）下能否存活？
criteria.how_to_measure: 压力测试：收入-30% 后的利息覆盖与现金跑道；阈值见 T-leverage-ebitda / T-interest-coverage（均 signal_only）

criteria.question: 价格与内在价值之间是否有显著差距？
criteria.maps_to_skill: Path B 步骤3 / Quick Filter Q8
evidence_quote: We insist on a margin of safety in our purchase price. If we calculate the value of a common stock to be only slightly higher than its price, we're not interested in buying. We believe this margin-of-safety principle, so strongly emphasized by Ben Graham, to be the cornerstone of investment success. (1992 letter)
criteria.how_to_measure: 方向是他本人坚持的；具体折价百分比（T-mos-tier）为 skill_author，仅 signal_only

criteria.question: 当前价格与内在价值的差距是否足够大？
source_refs: letter:1992 ('price is what you pay, value is what you get' 章节，需按原文补订引用位置)
criteria.philosophy_rule: 指标越一致地看空，越要回到生意本身重判，而不是加重否决
criteria.how_to_measure: 内在价值区间 + 对应确定性档；无法可靠估计 => 不投资

criteria.question: 结构性 / 财务性 / 行为性三类风险是否都查过？
source_refs: letter:1993 ('business risk' 等风险分类语境)
criteria.how_to_measure: 三类各至少一条具体风险或显式写无

criteria.question: 价格是否严重高估？
criteria.how_to_measure: 估值区间上沿 vs 现价

criteria.question: 基本面护城河是否已毁坏？
criteria.how_to_measure: C-moat-trend 判 narrowing 且不可逆

criteria.question: 管理层是否出现诚信问题？（是 => 立即卖）
criteria.veto_rationale: 与 C-mgmt-integrity 同源：bad-person 原话；持仓期间触发即立即卖出，不等估值
criteria.how_to_measure: 欺诈/侵占/重大隐瞒证据

criteria.question: 是否存在显著更好的机会？
criteria.how_to_measure: 机会成本比较；无候选则判 No
